_comment: BOOT TO AUX - the minimal build, confirmed on hardware 2026-09-28 (NAV 5.43.A.R2): the same three patch sets as the car build that booted to AUX three times (builds/aux-boot-restore.json), without its ring tone and spy-dump extras. aux-autoswitch keeps AUX available (IsAUXSRCAvailable; its second edit is inert but kept so the bytes are exactly those confirmed), aux-boot-default forces the boot restore target to AUX, and aux-boot-restore lets AUX's boot request take part in that restore. Neither of the last two boots to AUX on its own. App-image only: no /USER_DATA payload, so paired phones, destinations and presets are untouched. See docs/VERIFICATION.md and docs/PATCHES.md. Edit `package` and `out` to your paths.
